title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 17: where sacrifices must be brought, why blood may not be eaten, and eating what dies of itself.

questions.text: Where must an Israelite bring a bull, lamb or goat he kills, to offer it to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He must bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh's tabernacle.

answers.text: To any altar in the open field
To the elders at the city gate
To his own tent
To the door of the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: What is imputed to the man who does not bring his animal there?
questions.explanation: Blood shall be imputed to that man; he has shed blood, and he shall be cut off from among his people.

answers.text: Theft
Blood
A debt of silver
Nothing, if he gives a tithe

questions.text: What does the priest burn for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The priest sprinkles the blood on Yahweh's altar and burns the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

answers.text: The skin
The head
The fat
The breast

questions.text: To whom were the Israelites no longer to sacrifice?
questions.explanation: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols.

answers.text: The goat idols
The sun and the moon
The golden calf
The gods of the sea

questions.text: Besides the house of Israel, who else must bring a burnt offering to the door of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: The law applies to any man of the house of Israel or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them.

answers.text: Only the priests, the sons of Aaron
Only the elders of each tribe
The strangers who live among them
No one outside the house of Israel

questions.text: Where does Yahweh say the life of the flesh is?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'For the life of the flesh is in the blood.'

answers.text: In the blood
In the heart
In the breath
In the bones

questions.text: For what purpose has Yahweh given the blood on the altar?
questions.explanation: He has given it on the altar to make atonement for their souls.

answers.text: To feed the priests and their families
To make atonement for their souls
To mark the borders of the camp
To heal the sick among the people

questions.text: What must a hunter do with the blood of an animal or bird that may be eaten?
questions.explanation: He shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust.

answers.text: Bring it to the priest
Drink it on the day of the hunt
Mix it with oil for the altar
Pour it out and cover it with dust

questions.text: What must someone do after eating an animal that died of itself or was torn by animals?
questions.explanation: He shall wash his clothes, bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening; then he shall be clean.

answers.text: Offer a ram as a trespass offering to Yahweh
Fast and pray alone for seven full days
Wash his clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening
Leave the camp and live outside for a month

questions.text: What happens if he does not wash his clothes or bathe?
questions.explanation: If he doesn't wash them or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

answers.text: He must pay a fine
He shall bear his iniquity
He is stoned outside the camp
His food becomes holy
